aggregation: one prospective scalar per held-out context x perturbation; other-three-context mean is the fixed transfer aggregation
confirmation_set: disjoint perturbation identities outside the 638 A1 discovery panel. This is condition-independent but shares experimental sources; an additional external-dataset replication is required for fully source-independent certification.
controls: held-out true effect RMS log2 fold change
held-out number of significant DE genes at FDR<0.05
perturbed cell count and unique mapped-control count
checkpoint selection (best primary; last secondary where same primary metric becomes available)
representation (ST-SE target; ST-HVG sensitivity is not treated as independent confirmation)
training-panel mean number of DE genes as alternate magnitude proxy
deduplication: one condition per normalized context and perturbation; feature duplicates rejected; discovery perturbation names excluded globally from confirmation
direction: lower expected effect magnitude predicts lower signed-LFC Spearman performance
distance_metric: negative log1p of training-panel mean RMS log2 fold change, so larger spectral parameter means weaker expected perturbation
error_spending_plan: if directionally consistent but inconclusive, acquire an external perturbation dataset/checkpoint and use O'Brien-Fleming alpha1=.0056, cumulative alpha2=.05; never re-peek the same confirmation set
fixed_reference: transfer-the-training-context mean: mean real log2-fold-change vector for p in the three training contexts, evaluated against held-out real p using the identical signed Spearman metric
gene_set: the fixed, identically indexed 2,000 official STATE output features; complete finite features only

hypothesis_discovery_evidence.strongest_to_weakest_direction: performance fell from rho 0.2780 in strongest expected-effect quintile to 0.0210 in weakest

hypothesis_source: outcome-informed exploratory: nominated after the powered A1 distance axis was negative
inclusion_exclusion: official ST-SE-Replogle zero-shot best-checkpoint conditions excluded from the 638 A1 balanced perturbations; require target prediction and real DE plus real DE for the same perturbation in all three training contexts; exclude non-targeting; require complete finite metric and controls
level_rule: five equal-count levels within each held-out context, sorted from strongest expected response L1 to weakest expected response L5; stable mergesort of (magnitude, perturbation name) breaks ties
metric: primary signed Spearman correlation across all 2,000 finite features between predicted and real log2 fold-change vectors; Fisher-z continuous regression and raw-rho five-level SPC
normalization: log2 of official cell-eval fold_change, RMS within context and perturbation, arithmetic mean across the other three contexts, then log1p for regression
power_plan: score all eligible disjoint conditions once after this contract is hashed; no subgroup or threshold changes
prospective_features: for held-out context c and perturbation p, arithmetic mean over the other three training contexts of RMS log2 fold change across the same 2,000 output features; uses training-panel outcomes only and never the held-out outcome
sample_size_target: at least 263 confirmation conditions total and at least 40 per spectral level, retaining all eligible disjoint conditions in one look; 263 is the frozen conservative d=0.20, alpha=.05, 90% paired-power target inherited from A1

success_criteria.axis_order: five nontrivial within-context levels with at least 40 conditions each and strictly decreasing mean prospective magnitude
success_criteria.controls: weak-effect coefficient remains negative after held-out magnitude, nDE, and cell-count controls; if held-out magnitude fully explains it, re-attribute the finding to true effect magnitude and label training-panel magnitude a prospective proxy
success_criteria.degradation: continuous weak-effect coefficient on Fisher-z performance is negative with perturbation-block bootstrap 95% CI below zero and L5-minus-L1 raw rho is negative
success_criteria.reference: fixed transfer-mean reference scored on identical conditions/features/metric; retain a real shared degradation and call larger/comparable/smaller using the same +/-0.02 slope-difference ROPE

unit: held-out cell-line x genetic perturbation condition; perturbation families in confirmation are disjoint from A1 discovery
